name: james-heinrich/getid3
input_api: getID3::analyze(local tagged MP3 path); ID3v2 title/artist/album and major version
scope: ID3v2.3 title, artist, album, and major version
family: getID3 native MP3 and ID3v2 parser
family_note: Multi-format getID3 package; this adapter uses its own ID3v2 and MPEG audio parsers.

name: wapmorgan/mp3info
input_api: Mp3Info(local tagged MP3 path, parseTags=true); tags2 TIT2/TPE1/TALB and ID3v2 major version
scope: ID3v2.3 title, artist, album, and major version
family: Mp3Info native MP3 and ID3v2 parser
family_note: Own ID3v2.3 and MPEG audio parser; the pinned release README states that ID3v2.2 and v2.4 are unsupported.

name: christophwurst/id3parser
input_api: ID3Parser::analyze(local tagged MP3 path); ID3v2 comments title/artist/album and major version
scope: ID3v2.3 title, artist, album, and major version
family: getID3-derived ID3 tag parser
family_note: This package vendors a stripped-down getID3 ID3 implementation; it is a separate package path, not an independent parser family. Packagist marks it abandoned in favor of nextcloud/id3parser.

name: owen-oj/laravel-getid3
input_api: GetId3(local tagged MP3 path); getTitle/getArtist/getAlbum and extractInfo ID3v2 major version
scope: ID3v2.3 title, artist, album, and major version
family: getID3 native MP3 and ID3v2 parser
family_note: Laravel wrapper delegates to the same pinned james-heinrich/getid3 package in this lock; a separate package path, not an independent parser family.

name: wapmorgan/media-file
input_api: MediaFile::open(local tagged MP3 path); isAudio and getAudio sample rate/bit rate
scope: MP3 audio type, 8 kHz sample rate, and 32 kb/s bit rate on an ID3v2.3-tagged control
family: Mp3Info native MP3 and ID3v2 parser
family_note: MediaFile wraps the pinned wapmorgan/mp3info parser in its isolated lock. This adapter exposes audio properties, not the tag text; it is a separate package path, not an independent parser family.

name: kiwilan/php-audio
input_api: Audio::read(local tagged MP3 path); getTitle/getArtist/getAlbum
scope: ID3v2.3 title, artist, and album
family: getID3 native MP3 and ID3v2 parser
family_note: Audio delegates to james-heinrich/getid3 v1.9.22 in its isolated lock; this is a distinct wrapper package path but shares the getID3 parser family.

name: duncan3dc/meta-audio
input_api: Tagger::addDefaultModules(); Tagger::open(local tagged MP3 path); getTitle/getArtist/getAlbum
scope: ID3v2.4 title, artist, and album
family: duncan3dc MetaAudio native ID3 parser
family_note: Own PHP ID3v2 module; the documented default-module setup is required. The ID3v2.4 control uses synchsafe frame sizes.

name: debach/zend-mp3
input_api: Zend_Media_Id3v2(local tagged MP3 path); getFramesByIdentifier(TIT2/TPE1/TALB) and frame getText()
scope: ID3v2.3 title, artist, and album
family: Sven Vollbehr PHP Reader ID3 family
family_note: Composer fork of Sven Vollbehr PHP Reader; its ID3 parser shares source lineage with vollbehr/php-reader. A distinct package path, not an independent parser family.

name: mhor/php-mediainfo
input_api: MediaInfo::getInfo(local tagged MP3 path); getGeneral() title/performer/album
scope: ID3v2.3 title, performer, and album on an 18-second MP3
family: MediaInfoLib native MP3 and ID3 parser
family_note: Composer wrapper invokes the external MediaInfo 26.10 CLI; this is a package path over the MediaInfoLib parser family. The longer valid control is needed for the backend to read sufficient audio bytes.

name: buggedcom/phpvideotoolkit
input_api: PHPVideoToolkit\MediaParser::getFileInformation(local tagged MP3 path); metadata title/artist/album and audio sample rate/codec
scope: ID3v2.3 text fields and MP3 audio codec/sample rate
family: FFmpeg native MP3 and ID3 parser
family_note: Composer package delegates to the local FFmpeg/FFprobe backend; separate PHP wrapper package path, not an independent parser family. Pinned source LICENSE.md offers MIT, while composer.json also lists GPL-3.0+.

name: vollbehr/php-reader
input_api: FileReader(local tagged MP3 path) passed to Vollbehr\Media\Id3v2; getFramesByIdentifier(TIT2/TPE1/TALB) and frame getText()
scope: ID3v2.3 title, artist, and album
family: Sven Vollbehr PHP Reader ID3 family
family_note: Modern framework-agnostic PHP Reader release; same original author and code lineage as debach/zend-mp3, but distinct Composer package path.

name: pyrex-fwi/id3
input_api: Id3Metadata(local tagged MP3 path) passed to MediainfoWrapper::read; getTitle/getArtist/getAlbum
scope: ID3v2.3 title, artist, and album on an 18-second MP3
family: MediaInfoLib native MP3 and ID3 parser
family_note: Composer wrapper invokes MediaInfo 26.10. The committed executable shim changes its requested --Output=XML to --Output=OLDXML, matching the schema this pinned package expects; no parser output is fabricated.

name: sempia/getid3
input_api: JamesHeinrich\GetID3\GetID3::analyze(local tagged MP3 path); tags.id3v2 title/artist/album and ID3v2 major version
scope: ID3v2.3 title, artist, album, and major version
family: getID3 native MP3 and ID3v2 parser
family_note: Namespaced PSR-4 fork periodically merged from upstream getID3; distinct Composer release path, same underlying getID3 parser family.

name: indiehd/audio-manipulator
input_api: IndieHD\AudioManipulator\MediaParsing\MediaParser::analyze(local tagged MP3 path); tags.id3v2 title/artist/album and ID3v2 major version
scope: ID3v2.3 title, artist, album, and major version
family: getID3 native MP3 and ID3v2 parser
family_note: Public MediaParserInterface specifies analyze(string $file), and implementation delegates to pinned james-heinrich/getid3 v1.9.23. Separate package path, same underlying getID3 parser family.

name: wikimedia/getid3
input_api: JamesHeinrich\GetID3\GetID3::analyze(local tagged MP3 path); ID3v2 title/artist/album and major version
scope: ID3v2.3 title, artist, album, and major version
family: getID3 native MP3 and ID3v2 parser
family_note: Wikimedia fork of the upstream namespaced getID3 beta; distinct Composer package path, shared getID3 parser lineage.

name: nicoverbruggen/mediaprobe
input_api: MediaProbe(local tagged MP3 path)::getMediaInfo(); format.tags title/artist/album
scope: ID3v2.3 title, artist, and album through FFprobe
family: FFmpeg native MP3 and ID3 parser
family_note: Composer wrapper delegates to local FFprobe 9.0.2; package path over the FFmpeg parser family, not an independent decoder.

name: dgoriaev/mp3info
input_api: dgoriaev\Mp3Info\Mp3Info(local tagged MP3 path, parseTags=true); tags2 TIT2/TPE1/TALB and ID3v2 major version
scope: ID3v2.3 title, artist, album, and major version
family: Mp3Info native MP3 and ID3v2 parser
family_note: Fork of wapmorgan/Mp3Info with a changed namespace; distinct Composer package path, shared Mp3Info parser lineage.

name: codememory/media-file-fork
input_api: wapmorgan\MediaFile\MediaFile::open(local tagged MP3 path); isAudio and getAudio sample rate/bit rate
scope: MP3 audio type, 8 kHz sample rate, and 32 kb/s bit rate on an ID3v2.3-tagged control
family: Mp3Info native MP3 and ID3v2 parser
family_note: Fork of MediaFile; its pinned lock still delegates MP3 parsing to wapmorgan/mp3info. This API exposes MP3 audio properties rather than tag text.

name: phpmlkit/soundfile
input_api: sf_info(local tagged MP3 path) and sf_metadata(local tagged MP3 path); MPEG Layer III signal properties and title/artist/album
scope: ID3v2.3 title, artist, album plus MPEG Layer III format and 8 kHz sample rate
family: libsndfile native MP3 and ID3 parser
family_note: PHP FFI binding to the package-distributed libsndfile 1.2.2 library. The platform installer plugin was disabled; the pinned distribution contains the darwin-arm64 native binary used in this run.

name: audiostreamify/hvap
input_api: Processor::audio(local tagged MP3 path)->analyze(); ID3v2 title/artist/album and major version
scope: ID3v2.3 title, artist, album, and major version
family: getID3 native MP3 and ID3v2 parser
family_note: The documented Audio constructor accepts a file path and the ID3Tags trait documents analyze(); the pinned package delegates to james-heinrich/getid3 v1.9.28. Other HVAP features require Linux tools, but this read API passed on macOS.
